member.summary:
Records a checkpoint scan.
A scan taken outside the checkpoint radius is stored with IsWithinRange = 0 rather than rejected. Refusing it would leave no record at all, and the supervisor would see a missed round instead of a guard who scanned from 80 m away. A visible exception beats missing data.

member.name: M:Diti365.Api.Controllers.V2.OperationsController.PingBatch(Diti365.Api.Controllers.V2.PingBatchRequest)
member.summary:
The phone's location outbox in one call.
A batch containing spoofed pings is still accepted: rejecting the whole batch would throw away a shift of genuine offline history because of one bad row, which is exactly wrong for an offline-first client. The flagged rows are stored, excluded from the live board, and counted in the reply.

member.name: T:Diti365.Api.Filters.TenantGuardFilter
member.summary:
Rejects any request that tries to supply its own tenant identifier.
CompanyID comes from the JWT and nowhere else. Without this filter a caller could append ?companyId=2 and a repository that forgot to ignore it would leak another agency's data. Failing the request outright is the only reliable defence, because it does not depend on every one of 150 procedures being called correctly.
